props.name: blocks
props.description: The content, in reading order. Blocks are never split; one taller than a page is flagged.

props.name: margins
props.description: Page margins in millimetres — one number for all four sides. Header and footer sit inside the top and bottom margins.

props.name: footer
props.description: Running footer on every page. Defaults to “Page X of Y”.

props.name: title
props.description: Name of the document, for the landmark and the print button.

props.name: printable
props.description: Owns the page when printed: everything else is hidden and the pages print at full size. One per page.
